room_description: A modern, metallic bunker or control room featuring diamond-plate walls, black statues, a hanging fireplace, a computer desk, and a large central metal door.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the metallic bunker.
Finding a silver coin near the base of a statue.
Collecting an unlit torch handle from the fireplace grate.
Looking at the wall clock to see the time '4:15'.
Retrieving a bottle of oil from the briefcase.
Using the coin to unscrew the panel on the desk.
Lighting the torch in the fireplace.
Using the lit torch to reveal a code hidden in a dark wall compartment.
Solving the gear rotation puzzle on the wall.

solution_steps: Examine the wall clock. The hands indicate the time 4:15.
Examine the desk calendar. The date circled is the 9th.
Use the code '4195' to unlock the briefcase on the floor.
Collect the torch handle from the floor.
Apply the oil from the briefcase to the torch.
Hold the oiled torch to the flames in the hanging fireplace to light it.
Find the dark, recessed compartment in the wall.
Use the lit torch to illuminate the interior.
Read the numbers revealed in the light: '2468'.
Use the coin to unscrew the flat panel on the desk.
Enter the code '2468' into the revealed keypad.
A wall panel opens showing gears. Rotate the rings to align the gaps, allowing the central mechanism to turn.

final_action: After completing the gear puzzle, the main heavy metal door in the center of the room opens, allowing the player to escape.
